privacy.title: Privacy notice
privacy.intro: Safiri (the data controller) uses as little personal data as it can. Your phone number is your account.
privacy.what: Your phone number and name, to make bookings, take M-PESA payments and send receipts. Trip and payment records, because tax and consumer law require them. Usage data, only if you allow it, to improve the app.
privacy.share: The lodges, guides and drivers on your trip (your name and phone only), Safaricom M-PESA for payments, and the SMS and WhatsApp services that send your codes and reminders. We never sell your data.
privacy.rights: You can withdraw any optional consent, download your data, or ask us to delete your account from Profile. We answer within 30 days. Booking and payment records are kept for 7 years as the law requires, then deleted.
privacy.contact: Questions or complaints: privacy@safiri.example, or the Office of the Data Protection Commissioner (odpc.go.ke).
